summary_1line: Bhishma recounts teachings praising renunciation: poverty and detachment bring peace, while desire for wealth breeds anxiety, suffering, and endless craving.

image_candidates.scene_text: A camel suddenly runs down the road with two young bulls tangled and dangling from a yoke around its neck while their owner watches helplessly.
A wandering ascetic sleeps peacefully on bare earth using his arm as a pillow beneath the open sky.
Manki stands watching in shock as his last possessions—two bulls—are carried away by a running camel across a dusty road.
